prv.title: Data & privacy
prv.sub: Your data in and out, customers’ privacy requests, and how long things are kept.
prv.overdueNote: {n} order(s) are past the period and still hold these facts. The clean-up runs in the background worker; if this does not go to zero within the hour, look at Reports › Server.

keep.h: What orders keep, and for how long
keep.d: For the risk checks an order keeps the internet address, the device and (when the customer shares it) the location; sign-ins, one-time codes, bulk enquiries and consent answers keep the internet address. The clean-up removes them after the period; the order, its money and its history stay.
keep.retentionHelp: 180 days by default. After this, the clean-up removes them from the order.
keep.erasureRequests: Take customers' requests to erase their details
keep.erasureHelp: Off by default. When on, the team can file a request below; only the owner carries it out.

kept.d: The standing rule for customers' details.
kept.never: Customers are never removed on their own. A customer, his orders, money and history stay, however long ago he last ordered.
kept.ipOnly: Only the internet address and the location go, after {n} days: from orders, sign-ins, one-time codes, bulk enquiries and consent answers. The rows themselves stay.
kept.byHand: Removing a customer's details is by hand only: a request below, carried out by the owner.

consent.d: Who agreed to offers by SMS or WhatsApp, and every change with when and where, is on Messages › Consent.

req.d: A customer asks for a copy of their data or to have it erased. Filing a request changes nothing; the owner carries it out. Money and stock records stay; the message log, the consent history, the security log and fraud checks are kept as the record.
req.off: Erasure requests are off. Turn them on in the card above to take one.
req.reason: What he asked, and how (phone, shop, message)
req.filed: Request filed. The owner can carry it out below.
confirmEffects: His name, numbers, e-mail, birthday, saved addresses and spoken addresses (the words and the recording) are removed from his profile and his orders. This cannot be undone.
His orders, their money and stock stay; the courier records keep the order numbers only.
He can no longer sign in; a new order makes a new profile.

kinds.COPY: wants a copy of their data

req.approved: Approved. He can download his copy from his account.
req.daysOver: {n} days past the time to answer

err.STALE: Someone else changed this card; it shows their values now.
err.CONFIRM_MISMATCH: Type the word exactly as shown.
err.OPEN_ORDERS: One of his orders is still on its way. Erase after it is delivered or returned.
err.ALREADY_REQUESTED: A request for this customer is waiting already.
err.NOT_WAITING: This request is already done or cancelled.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not work. Please try again.

prv.readOnly: You can see these settings; changing them needs the security permission.

cust.d: A signed-in customer asks from My account › Profile for a copy of his data or for its erasure. The request lands in the list below; nothing changes until you act. Off as it ships.
cust.needsErasure: Customers' own requests show on the shop only while erasure requests are on (the card above).
cust.enabled: Let customers ask from their account
cust.enabledHelp: Off as it ships. Off: no card on My account › Profile.
cust.copyDays: Days an approved copy can be downloaded
cust.copyDaysHelp: From the moment you approve it; then he must ask again.

loc.h: Shared location: where the team uses it
loc.d: A customer may tap "Share my location for the rider" at checkout. While the order keeps that point (the days above), it can help the team and the rider. Never on a gift, never after the days. Both off as shipped.
loc.orderPage: Map link on the order page
loc.orderPageHelp: Off as shipped. On: the order's Customer card shows the point and opens it on the map below (a new tab).
loc.sticker: Print the point on the courier sticker
loc.stickerHelp: Off as shipped. On: the sticker prints "Location 23.781, 90.412" small under the address, for the rider.
loc.mapLinkHelp: Starts with https:// and has {lat} and {lng} in it; the point fills them in.

board.waiting: {n} customer request(s) waiting. Answer within {days} days.

export.allSoon: Use Backups & restore for a full copy
export.pinText: This file has phone numbers and addresses. Keep it safe. The export is recorded in the activity log.
export.partial: ZIP downloaded without the files you may not export

keep.hint: Orders and money records are always kept for accounts — they are never removed.

import.text: Bring customers from the old WordPress shop or a spreadsheet (name, phone, district). Duplicates by phone are merged, not doubled.

own.h: “My own data” — never copied to a new shop
own.hint: If this system is ever set up for another shop, these stay yours. Every setting also has “Back to default”.

fresh.text: Clears all test and sample business data so the live shop starts from zero. Use it once, on go-live day.

board.moreSub: How long orders keep the internet address, device and shared location, customers' own requests, shared location, what is kept for good and consent.

err.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can do this.
err.SWITCHED_OFF: The customer export is switched off. Turn it on in Customers first.
err.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: There are more people than one file holds. Export from the Customers page with a narrower list.
err.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.
err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Wait a while.
